title: [DEV-M] Widget is broken
symptom: The widget is frozen after the update, re-adding (after deleting) is not possible. Widget is available but will not install.
cause: The issue is likely related to Samsung One UI 5.x, as multiple users with Samsung phones experienced the problem, while others on Pixel devices did not. The exact root cause is not explicitly stated, but a fix was provided in PR #2850.
fix: Including PR #2850 (by HuismanErik) in the build fixed the widget issue. Users confirmed that after applying this change, the widget can be added again.
evidence_quote: I did a reinstall with this change https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/2850 and it fixed the Widget
